def transform8(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; out=[row[:] for row in g]
    from collections import Counter,deque
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if seen[i][j]: continue
            c=g[i][j]; q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i][j]=True; comp=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); comp.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and not seen[ny][nx] and g[ny][nx]==c:
                        seen[ny][nx]=True; q.append((ny,nx))
            if len(comp)==1:
                y,x=comp[0]
                nb=[g[y+dy][x+dx] for dy in(-1,0,1) for dx in(-1,0,1) if (dy or dx) and 0<=y+dy<h and 0<=x+dx<w]

def transform10(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cs=comps(g); bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    removed={p for c,comp in cs if len(comp)<=4 for p in comp}
    out=[row[:] for row in g]

        out[y][x]=cands[0] if len(cands)==1 else bg
